rows.actual_answer: WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT。[ev_page_596b869ab04906c42498ed66] 若 ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL 则继续，否则 MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON。[ev_page_596b869ab04906c42498ed66] 后面的到期日检查失败会 MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON，因此 102 可能被后续覆盖。[ev_page_596b869ab04906c42498ed66]

required_findings.description: 临时余额为周期credit减debit加交易金额。
额度大于等于临时余额继续，超限写102。
到期日检查随后执行，失败可覆盖为103。
账户读取INVALID KEY写101，实际账户余额仍是外部文件数据。

rows.notes: 公式、比较方向和102被103覆盖均正确。未说明INVALID KEY写101，也未说明真实余额由外部文件提供；两者不是材料未供应，整段源程序已供。

以ACCOUNT-RECORD改写FD-ACCTFILE-REC。

mechanism_audit_findings.finding: Both raw public programs have parse_complete=false; COPY is unexpanded. Diagnostics include unsupported IF/INITIALIZE/STRING/MOVE operands.
mechanism_audit_findings.action: State partial frontend output with diagnostics, not full public-program parse success. Do not use lower runtime for a full-coverage speed winner.

mechanism_audit_findings.finding: v1 56/58 -> v2 58/58 follows changing CFG input from sparse business index to structural index, not modifying product code. Sparse direct CFG remains PARTIAL with perform_form_not_supported.
mechanism_audit_findings.action: Retain old failures and explain unsupported direct API input. Default business chain uses structural sidecar, but this fixture has not independently proved complete default-path section answer behavior.

mechanism_audit_findings.finding: Continuation fixture uses short fixed-format physical lines. Literal FIRSTSECOND is explicitly unscored because dialect padding semantics are unresolved; unsupported=0 covers scored checks only.
mechanism_audit_findings.action: Keep literal as unresolved; cannot claim full legal continuation conformance.

mechanism_audit_findings.finding: Warm parse excludes source reads and startup; new-process measurement includes startup/import/read over all 11. OS cache is uncontrolled. FactStore cached access is an object dictionary hit, not question processing.
evidence: baseline/timing.py measure calls and cold entrypoint
mechanism_audit_findings.action: Separate warm reparse, new-process parse, index creation, cached retrieval and end-to-end answer timing; no cross-category speed ratios.

mechanism_audit_findings.finding: fresh_factstore_query_count=2 counts rows() calls; constructor executes two additional SELECTs not included. It is not a total SQL statement count.
mechanism_audit_findings.action: Call this instrumented program data queries, or report total SQL only after independent tracing.

mechanism_audit_findings.finding: 1000 programs / 139000 lines contain no cross-file CALL/COPY. Initial index has one run. Sum of per-file medians is not median batch duration; 3/7 repetitions do not support a production p95 claim. RSS is whole Python process cumulative peak, excluding child process peaks.
mechanism_audit_findings.action: Treat as controlled breadth/index probe; no enterprise complexity or p95 claim. Do not imply cold disk or full answer timing.

mechanism_audit_findings.finding: Fixtures and public-development gold were used during implementation, not independent holdout. Shared role assertions compare exact identifiers correctly but mostly do not independently assert operators/constants/control predicates. Additional probes assert node kinds/edge labels, not arithmetic runtime values.
mechanism_audit_findings.action: Report narrow regression evidence; do not generalize to all COBOL business semantics or runtime arithmetic.
